plain_summary: This page details the business processes and documentation related to Cargo Dues Orders. It explains where and when Cargo Dues Orders must be presented, their validity upon invoicing, and the application of late cargo dues order fees if an order is in a pending status. It clarifies who is responsible for paying cargo dues (importer/exporter) and how charges are billed in cases where orders are not received (container operator for container traffic, vessel agent for bulk/breakbulk). The page also defines how empty ISO containers and new empty ISO containers are treated for cargo dues purposes, with an exception for transhipments. Finally, it describes how Cargo Dues Orders can be grouped and submitted as lists, specifying separation criteria for containers, breakbulk, and bulk cargo based on vessel, operator/agent, and movement type (deepsea, coastwise, transshipment). It also states that cancellations and amendments are applicable per cargo dues order.
